DNA replication initiation in Saccharomyces cerevisiae

Origin specification through bidirectional fork formation. Eleven steps on the main line, with legends, regulation, two competing accounts and six perturbations on a second chart. Shape carries function: where two proteins bind, the outline of one is cut to receive the other. Content follows Parker, Botchan and Berger (2017) and the work it cites.
